content: I would believe only in a God that knows how to dance.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
story:
Living in austere solitude across Alpine villages like Sils Maria and battling near-blindness and debilitating migraines, Nietzsche renounced conventional academia to diagnose the spiritual crisis of modern Europe. In heroic defiance of nihilism, he championed the affirmation of all existence—including pain—through the doctrine of Amor Fati (love of fate).

This insight points directly back to the quiet center of being. Friedrich Nietzsche observed that while the mind perpetually scatters itself into past regrets and future anxieties, peace is only ever discovered by anchoring attention in the immediate truth of this moment.
reflectionPrompt: What quiet yearning in your heart is asking for your attention and honest devotion?
